Technology Trader Wall Street on Facebook: Haters Gonna Hate Many users don’t trust the social network on privacy, and yet they can’t seem to give it up. By June 15, 2018 3:28 p.m. ET
Facebook can’t seem to find a friend these days.
At its Worldwide Developers Conference earlier this month, Apple (ticker: AAPL) demonstrated new technology that lets iPhone users limit their time on addictive apps—like Instagram, which of course is owned by Facebook.
